item.title: Goodstart 2026 Annual Report highlights resilience and commitment during "difficult year”
item.description: Goodstart Early Learning, Australia’s largest provider of early childhood education and care (ECEC) services, delivered a solid 2026 performance despite a challenging operating environment with a surplus of $10.9 million reported and sector leading results in areas such as quality, inclusion spending, retention and advocacy.

item.title: Who helps educators make sense of children’s learning?
item.description: A lunchbox that will not open, a friend who is away or not knowing where to go can be a matter of concern to a child. Their questions can highlight the areas we should help them prepare for. Where will I put my bag? What if I can’t open my lunch? Who will I play with if my friend isn’t there?
